g.text: Conservatoire Virtuel - principal classes and OOP relationships
Resource/student associations are ID-resolved through SchoolStore lists.
A Lesson requires exactly one teacher, one room and >=1 instrument.
Individual: 1 participant; group: >=2 participants; 60 minutes each.
The catalog offer and its owned enrollment snapshot are distinct copies.
Unlimited has no finite minute allowance; use isUnlimited() first.
